feature: 2D Camera Mode and Orthographic Scene Authoring

browser.interactionBoundary: Blank project creation, palette drag placement, Inspector edits, Camera View, local Sprite image import, nine-slice guide authoring, pixel sampling, flip, direction, parallax registry/assignment, Save, reload, Load Selected, validation, and both exports used visible controls. No project state was injected into the visible run.

cameras.zInvariantEvidence: At height 6 the same Sprite/Billboard/Mesh composition retained its displayed scale when camera Z changed from 10 to 30; the independent export audit compares matrix scale terms exactly.

scene.animationCompatibility: Covered by Phase 021-025 focused and integrated regression suites; no new animation data model was introduced.

limitations: Numeric Orthographic Height is used instead of a direct frame-resize handle.
Pixel-perfect scaling, follow/bounds cameras, UI Canvas, 2D physics/controllers, and Phase 029 remain deferred.
